messages.author: 28f7cf43544f2467
messages.subject: DF summary question.
parts:
I've got a dataframe that I need to summarize.

df =
data.frame(Date=c("2010-04-14","2010-04-14","2010-04-15","2010-04-15","2010-04-16","2010-04-16"),Machine=c("MachA","MachB","MachA","MachB","MachA","MachB"),Count1=c( 1000,1500,2000,2500,3000,3500),Count2=c(1000,2000,3000,4000,5000,6000))

I'd like to sum the Count1 and Count2 variables by Date. Would this
fall into the realm of ddply or plyr?

--
